complete_examples.text: However, the influences on the slab acceleration, concrete base acceleration, fastener tension force are large, and the influence on the slab bending stress is huge.

As illustrated in Fig. 13b–d, the maximum slab acceleration is larger than the rail and concrete base accelerations when f is larger than 45 °C/m. The reason is that the fastener has the vibration-reduction capacity and can reduce the vibration induced by the gap under slab, so the rail acceleration is less than the slab acceleration.
